We are proud of the contributions of our faculty, staff, students and alumni and will expand our community outreach through continued focus on our public service mission. Cybersecurity Camp The School of Management, School of Engineering and Applied Sciences, and the Center of Excellence in Information Systems Assurance Research and Education at UB hold an annual camp for teens that encourages them to pursue career opportunities in cybersecurity. Free Tax Preparation Each spring, IRS-certified accounting students from the UB School of Management's chapter of Beta Alpha Psi and the UB Accounting Association provide free tax preparation services to qualifying individuals and families. Helping Small Business The School of Management's Center for Entrepreneurial Leadership works to enhance the talents and operating abilities of entrepreneurs in the Western New York community. MBA Consulting Group The UB MBA Consulting Group is a pro bono, student-run firm that selects projects to complete each semester for small- to medium-sized businesses or nonprofits. Nonprofit Board Fellowship The Nonprofit Board Fellowship introduces MBA students to the intrinsic value of board service, through a foundational curriculum that blends concepts of board governance, servant leadership and diversity and inclusion with an academic year of service with local nonprofits. Projects Clinic Clinic interns work with our partner companies to solve real problems. Working in small teams, our interns leverage the skills they learn in the classroom, while also bringing their own perspective to create positive change within our partner organizations. Social Impact Fellows UB MBA and MSW students, along with graduate students from the College of Arts and Sciences, create social innovation in Western New York through collaboration to address pressing social issues. Student Clubs In their commitment to serving others, School of Management student clubs take on a variety of volunteer projects to help make a positive impact in the community. Western New York Prosperity Scholars Funded by the Prentice Family Foundation, WNY Prosperity scholars are awarded a paid internship, scholarship support and an enrichment fund to actively prepare them for careers that further local economic development and growth. Give now Far Beyond Business as Usual As one of the world's best business schools, the UB School of Management is continually on the rise. Now, with your support, we will aim higher still: a transformation of business education and the very future of management. How? By advancing thought leadership. By providing student experiences that develop leadership to the fullest. By leading through example. At UB, we’re not just teaching business innovation. We’re driving it. Here Is How We Create Graduates Prepared to Lead Anywhere Here, we build connections across cultures and prepare our graduates for success in today’s ever-changing global marketplace. With your investment, we’ll: Endow award-winning programs like LeaderCORE™, which builds MBA students’ abilities to solve problems, motivate, communicate and collaborate, and expand it to other Schools and degree program across the University Foster international exchange by expanding our Center for Global Programs, boosting study-abroad opportunities and preparing our international students to return home as leaders Allow more students to build programs with sustainable impact Substantially increase undergraduate and graduate scholarships Provide a new campus learning environment, including creating a Living and Learning space for our students to form cohorts and fuel innovation Develop curriculum and programming that will prepare our students to launch successful entrepreneurial ventures Here Is How We Help Organizations Work Smarter Our faculty engage business and industry directly, from working with health care organizations to redefining accounting practices and standards. Philanthropy will allow us to bring more faculty thought leaders to UB and Buffalo with the addition of new endowed chair and professor positions. Your investment also will enable a dramatic expansion of interdisciplinary research and collaborations, such as our pioneering Stephen Still Institute for Sustainable Transportation and Logistics. Here, we put our ingenuity to the ultimate test: We put it to work. Here Is How We Build a Stronger Buffalo and a Better World Our students serve as interns and volunteer business consultants. Our faculty consult and collaborate with businesses and industries. Now, with your investment we will expand and strengthen those collaborations by endowing these dynamic programs: Social Innovation activities—including Social Impact Fellowships and Nonprofit Board Fellowships—training our students to address complex issues through a multidisciplinary lens, while making a direct impact for local businesses and organizations The Center for Entrepreneurial Leadership, helping startup executives launch ventures that survive and succeed The Center for Leadership and Organizational Effectiveness, providing innovative programming for managers and organizations Join us on our path to ground-breaking business education and leadership development. We are seeking your investment in creating global business leaders. Now, we seek visionary donors who recognize that bold investments in knowledge, leadership and skills yield immense returns—for UB, our graduates, our community and our world. We proudly invite you to partner with us, to work with us to build a future for business that is world-changing. UB Fund: Immediate Support for Students When you give to the UB Fund, your gift today is made available to help support students today . It’s that immediate. Giving to the UB Fund helps ensure our students have everything they need to become thoughtful global citizens, with 100 percent of gifts used to enhance the student experience, including crucial support for research, study abroad, student emergencies and community service opportunities.
